## 3. Log in

### Without a browser (scripts, agents, remote shells)

```sh
printf '%s' "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" | kogen provider login anthropic
printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_CODE_TOKEN" | kogen provider login claude-code
```

Get the Claude Code token from `claude setup-token`. A person must supply the secret. ChatGPT requires a browser on the same machine at port 1455 and has no unattended form.
